bio.text: Brian Bengs, of Hot Springs, is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in South Dakota in 2026, challenging Republican Sen. Mike Rounds.
He is a retired U.S. Air Force lieutenant colonel with a law degree who formerly taught at Northern State University in Aberdeen and worked as a ranger at Wind Cave National Park.
Bengs ran for the Senate in 2022 as a Democrat against Sen. John Thune, receiving 26% of the vote.

sources.title: Musk DOGE cuts motivate former U.S. Senate candidate to run again
